fusions.name: Lazy Mouthful
fusions.desc: Lobs a slow bubble that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. 25% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Heavy Drift
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles, slows it by 25% for 3 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mending
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thick Blubber
fusions.desc: When something other than fire hurts you, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health covers you for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
